2026-09-14ITCanadian Commercial Corporation ActReappointment of the Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Canadian Commercial CorporationReappointment of Douglas Harrison of Burlington, Ontario, as Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Canadian Commercial Corporation, to hold office during pleasure for a term of eighteen months, or until such time as a new Chairperson is appointed, whichever comes first.N/A
subject: Reappointment of the Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Canadian Commercial Corporation
precis: Reappointment of Douglas Harrison of Burlington, Ontario, as Chairperson of the Board of Directors of the Canadian Commercial Corporation, to hold office during pleasure for a term of eighteen months, or until such time as a new Chairperson is appointed, whichever comes first.
